what: IAMGOLD mines gold in Canada and West Africa. Its largest asset is the Côté mine in Ontario, which started production in 2024, alongside the Essakane mine in Burkina Faso.
customers: Refiners and bullion markets; gold sells at a world price.
money: a new large open pit mine in Ontario
an open pit mine in Burkina Faso
moat: Côté is a long-life, large-scale mine in Canada, the kind of asset that takes a decade to permit and build and that cannot be replaced.
risks: Essakane is in Burkina Faso, where the government has raised mining taxes and security is poor
Earnings follow the gold price entirely
Only seven analysts cover the stock
opportunities: 6.8 times earnings and 5.0 times free cash flow with $1.7B of free cash flow
Revenue grew from $987M to $2.9B in two years as Côté ramped up
Analysts see about 50% upside, and Côté's production is still rising toward its design rate
watch: Côté's throughput and all-in sustaining cost per ounce.
